composition: All eight plates share one cozy 16:9 pastel winter clearing with a wide open center for Naeru.

clear_day.prompt: Preserve the central clearing, mountain horizon and side-framing trees while repainting winter with rounded snow-laden evergreens and shrubs, thick snow pillows, broad matte gouache brushwork and a milky blue, lavender, ivory and blush pastel palette. Keep the scene plush and cozy rather than thin or barren.

clear_time_edits.dawn.png: Preserve the day geometry and style; use pale periwinkle and lavender dawn with restrained peach-rose light near the horizon.
clear_time_edits.dusk.png: Preserve the day geometry and style; use muted lavender above and warm apricot, rose and peach-gold near the horizon.
clear_time_edits.night.png: Preserve the day geometry and style; use a rich gentle indigo sky, restrained stars, dim moonlit clouds and luminous lavender-blue snow without black shadows.

snow_weather.day-rain.png: Preserve the exact cozy clear-day geometry and repaint only the weather and illumination as a hushed overcast snow day with layered blue-gray and muted lavender snow clouds. Do not paint falling flakes.
snow_weather.dawn-rain.png: Preserve the exact overcast geometry and clouds; shift only the lighting to blue-lavender predawn with a faint muted peach-gray horizon.
snow_weather.dusk-rain.png: Preserve the exact overcast geometry and clouds; shift only the lighting to smoky lavender and mauve dusk with a weak rose-apricot horizon.
snow_weather.night-rain.png: Preserve the exact overcast geometry and clouds; shift only the lighting to deep indigo snow-cloud night with clearly legible blue-lavender snow and no stars.

foreground.prompt: Create a genuine-transparent foreground overlay matching the cozy day plate: low rounded snow-capped evergreen foliage, a few dormant twigs and small seed heads only in the extreme lower corners. Keep the middle and all upper areas transparent; no ground plane, landscape, character, haze or detached speckles.

landscape.prompt: Extract the complete day landscape as transparent RGBA while removing only the sky and clouds. Preserve exact snowfield, mountains, trees, trunks, branches, shrubs, snow caps, alignment and antialiased boundaries.

cloud_layers.prompt: For each clear time plate, create one cloudless sky base with all non-sky geometry fixed and one genuine-transparent extraction of only the open-sky clouds with exact time-specific color, position and soft edges.
